similarityReview: The submarine hull is modeled using a combination of a long cylinder for the main body and a rounded wedge for the bow. The sail (conning tower) is constructed with a box and rounded edges to match the profile. All components are integrated to form a watertight hull. The rear control surfaces are modeled with wedges, and the propeller is represented by a cylinder and torus. The scale is set to approximately 100m in length.
